intro: Au Cheval is the upscale Chicago diner, with a New York location too, whose cheeseburger is regularly called one of the best in America. Beyond the burger it serves an elevated diner menu: a fried bologna sandwich, General Jane's honey-fried chicken, crispy fries topped with a farm egg, and rich egg dishes. It is a full-service restaurant known for long waits, not a fast-food chain. Below is the Au Cheval menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Au Cheval, the famous cheeseburger is about $19.99 single and $20.99 double, the fried bologna sandwich is $18.99, and General Jane's honey-fried chicken is $26.99. French fries are $9.99 and the crispy fries with a farm egg are $15.99. It is an upscale diner, so prices are higher than fast food, and the burger is the icon.
hot_deal: Au Cheval value: the single cheeseburger ($19.99) is the signature order and the thing to get, and adding thick-cut peppered bacon ($16.99 as a side, or on the burger) is the classic move. French fries ($9.99) are the cheapest add-on. It is an upscale diner, so there is no value menu; the burger itself is the draw. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is the Au Cheval cheeseburger?
faqs.a: The Au Cheval cheeseburger is about $19.99 for a single and $20.99 for a double. Adding thick-cut peppered bacon or a fried egg costs extra. It is regularly ranked among the best cheeseburgers in America, which is why it draws long waits.

Au Cheval started as a diner in the West Loop of Chicago and has a New York City location as well. It is a single upscale restaurant in each city, known for long waits, rather than a chain. There is also a smaller spin-off, Small Cheval, for a quicker burger.

faqs.q: What is Au Cheval known for?
faqs.a: Au Cheval is known above all for its cheeseburger, often called the best in America, served on a griddle-crusted patty with cheese and optional thick-cut bacon and a fried egg. It is also known for the fried bologna sandwich and General Jane's honey-fried chicken.
No. As an upscale sit-down diner, Au Cheval does not publish calorie counts, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. The burger is rich, but no official figure is published.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Au Cheval?
faqs.a: The best known are the cheeseburger, the fried bologna sandwich, General Jane's honey-fried chicken, the crispy fries with a farm egg, and the thick-cut peppered bacon.
